page_title: LIL 1-0 MAR | Lille v Marseille 05/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

90+2' Darryl Bakola (Marseille) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
90+1' Berke Ozer (Lille) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
90' Romain Perraud (Lille) is able to continue to play.
87' Romain Perraud (Lille) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
85' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Andre Gomes (Lille) coming on for Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
81' PENALTY APPEAL after Mason Greenwood (Marseille) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
80' Roberto De Zerbi prepares a substitution. Igor Paixao is replaced by Tadjidine Mmadi (Marseille).
80' Here comes a substitution. Geoffrey Kondogbia is given a rest as he is replaced by Bilal Nadir (Marseille).
79' Robinio Vaz (Marseille) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jerome Brisard who sees an offensive foul.
79' A snap shot by Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Berke Ozer produces a good save to thwart him.
78' Igor Paixao (Marseille) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
76' Igor Paixao (Marseille) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

76' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Berke Ozer makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom left corner. Marseille win a corner.
74' Olivier Giroud is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille).
72' Half-chance! Robinio Vaz (Marseille) plays a pass into the box, but Berke Ozer reacts well to snuff out the attack.
71' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
70' Substitution. Osame Sahraoui makes his way off the pitch and Felix Correia (Lille) comes on as his replacement.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) for Ethan Mbappe.
67' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
66' Here is a change. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Robinio Vaz (Marseille).
66' It is time for a substitution. Darryl Bakola (Marseille) is on for Benjamin Pavard.

64' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
62' Geronimo Rulli leaps to intercept the corner kick from Ethan Mbappe (Lille).

61' Romain Perraud (Lille) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Lille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
60' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
58' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
57' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
57' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
56' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Mason Greenwood (Marseille).

56' Arthur Vermeeren (Marseille) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The linesman points to the corner flag, Marseille are going to take it.
54' Timothy Weah (Marseille) commits a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
52' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) takes the corner with a short pass.
50' Thomas Meunier (Lille) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jerome Brisard signals.
48' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
46' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Jerome Brisard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
45+3' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) works the corner short.

45+3' Igor Paixao (Marseille) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball goes out for a corner. Marseille can continue in their attacking effort.
45+1' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' Emerson (Marseille) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Marseille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Olivier Giroud (Lille) heads on.
38' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Olivier Giroud picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.
33' Benjamin Andre (Lille) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
28' The ball is cleared after Mason Greenwood (Marseille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
27' Olivier Giroud (Lille) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
26' Arthur Vermeeren (Marseille) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
26' Hamza Igamane is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Olivier Giroud (Lille).
24' Hamza Igamane (Lille) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
21' Hamza Igamane (Lille) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
20' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle and it's Romain Perraud (Lille) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
18' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

18' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat. Lille will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
16' Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Igor Paixao (Marseille) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
13' Rough tackle by Ethan Mbappe (Lille). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Excellent touch by Romain Perraud (Lille)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.

10' 1 - 0 Nabil Bentaleb sends a lovely ball into Ethan Mbappe (Lille). He latches on to it and shoots low into the middle of the goal from the edge of the box. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
5' Jerome Brisard blows for a foul after Timothy Weah (Marseille) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

3' Romain Perraud (Lille) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Lille will kick the game off.
Jerome Brisard will officiate today.
